evidence.quote: Tim Race Partner and Senior Analyst Tim joined Trinity Street in 2019. Tim is a generalist but also provides Trinity Street with extensive insights on the Healthcare sector, having previously headed the Pharmaceuticals & Biotech equity research team at a large investment bank for the previous decade. Tim started his career as a strategy consultant, before moving to equities. He holds a BSc in Biology from the University of Nottingham and is a CFA charterholder.
